## 🎯 Objective

Describe what this feature will do and its main goal.

## 📋 Remaining Tasks
- [ ] Define technical structure
- [ ] Implement core logic
- [ ] Connect to backend
- [ ] Test functionality
- [ ] Document usage

## 🔧 Technical Requirements

What libraries, APIs, or tools are needed?  
Mention any performance or compatibility considerations.

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria

- Works as intended across all screens/devices
- Meets expected UX flow
- No performance issues or errors
